scope: The same public reference plus synthetic stock/fleet/route question. No report data queried.
timingCaveat: One sequential local observation; cache, source pushdown and connection warm-up differ. This is not a speed benchmark or measured NGO staff-time saving.
observations: The USL owns cross-source joins and aggregate definitions. The manual baseline owns grouping, matching, type normalization and provenance-related fields in application code.
sources: SELECT s.place_id, s.name, l.depot_id, l.simulated FROM PORTALONE_COMMUNITY_V1.sites s JOIN PORTALONE_COMMUNITY_V1.logistics_scope l ON s.place_id=l.place_id
SELECT depot_id, available_units, expires_at, simulated FROM PORTALONE_LOGISTICS_V1.inventory
SELECT route_id, sequence, from_node, distance_km, travel_minutes, max_gross_kg, expires_at, simulated FROM PORTALONE_SCENARIO_V1.route_segments
semanticSql: SELECT c.place_id, c.name, d.depot_id, d.stock_units, d.available_vehicles, r.route_id, r.distance_km, r.travel_minutes, r.max_gross_kg, d.stock_expires_at, r.expires_at, l.simulated AND d.simulated AND r.simulated AS simulated FROM lightning.metastore.portalone.mission_intelligence_v1.communities c JOIN lightning.metastore.portalone.mission_intelligence_v1.community_logistics l ON c.place_id=l.place_id JOIN lightning.metastore.portalone.mission_intelligence_v1.depots d ON l.depot_id=d.depot_id JOIN lightning.metastore.portalone.mission_intelligence_v1.route_options r ON d.depot_id=r.depot_id ORDER BY r.route_id
